chunks: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Whoever has firmly established in him a characteristic from the characteristics of goodness, I shall be tolerant of him on account of it and forgive the absence of whatever else besides it. But I shall not forgive the absence of intellect nor of religion.

Because the separation from religion is the separation from security, and there is no enjoyment of life alongside fear; and the loss of intellect is the loss of life, and such a person can only be compared to the dead.

key_terms.الأمن: Security — both existential peace and the communal safety that religion provides
key_terms.خصال الخير: Characteristics of goodness — virtuous qualities or traits that define a person's moral character
key_terms.فقد العقل: Loss of intellect — the absence of reason, which Imam Ali equates with the loss of life itself
key_terms.مفارقة الدين: Separation from religion — abandonment of religious commitment, which destroys the foundation of security and well-being

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about tolerating faults versus the loss of intellect and religion?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates a hierarchy of virtues: he is willing to overlook many shortcomings if a person possesses even one genuine good quality, but he makes an absolute exception for the loss of intellect ('aql) and religion (din). The Imam explains this exception with two striking equations: abandoning religion means abandoning security, and losing one's intellect is equivalent to losing life itself — such a person can only be likened to the dead. This teaching reflects the foundational Shia view that intellect and religion are indivisible prerequisites for a truly human life, a teaching especially relevant to al-Kulayni's opening chapter on 'Aql as the cornerstone of religious obligation.
word_analysis: I shall be tolerant of him

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, said, 
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who sides with me<sup>asws</sup> that in him there is a characteristic from the characteristics of the goodness, I<sup>asws</sup> shall be tolerant upon it and forgive whatever was lost besides it, and I<sup>asws</sup> shall neither forgive the loss of intellect nor Religion, because the separation of the Religion is separation of the security, as life is not pleasant along with fear; and the loss of the intellect is loss of the life, and there is no comparison except with the dead ones’.
